purpose: Second-official-document corroboration of the slate: the referee-operations injury report prints Game Date / Game Time / Matchup on every row, independently confirming which games exist and their ET tip times.
why_this_matters: FLAG-SLATE-04 exists because www.nba.com/schedule prints tip times as a loose list. This document attaches the time to the matchup in the same table row, so agreement between the two documents upgrades the tip time to a two-source value.
reading_rules: A time is recorded only when the printed row for that matchup carries the time cell itself.
All 14 games in this release carry an explicit time cell, so all 14 times are captured.
Cross-check: all 14 times equal the schedule capture; zero conflicts.
time_convention: Stored in 24h ET, converted from the printed '(ET)' label: 07:00 (ET) -> 19:00, 10:30 (ET) -> 22:30. The document prints evening times on a 12-hour clock with an explicit (ET) suffix.

coverage.not_covered: 2026-11-15..17 games are absent from the 11/13 evening release; they appear in the reports for their own game day, which had not been published at build time.
